findings.description: John Nielssen was born in 1846; the 1877 Bygland baptism of his son Torjus gives the father, Jon Nilson, a birth year of 1846. No record found states his birthplace.

details.place: not stated (record from Bygland, Aust-Agder, Norway)

supporting_sources: Norway, Church Books, 1797-1958 — baptism entry for Torjus, son of Jon Nilson and Anne Torjusdatter, 17 Oct 1877, ark:/61903/1:1:683T-H1R2
